metadata.title: Top 100 Digital AI Companies 2026
metadata.subtitle: Ranked by a normalized composite of AI-attributed ARR and AI valuation

scoring.normalization: log-min-max scaling (log10 of the raw metric, then min-max rescaled to [0,1])
scoring.missing_data_policy: If ARR is undisclosed but a recent revenue or run-rate exists, we substitute it. If both metrics are missing the company is dropped from the ranked list. Companies with no disclosed AI revenue are kept only where a market-cap proxy is defensible, and are flagged 'proxy'.

valuation_bases.pure_play: Company is fundamentally an AI business. Its market or transaction valuation IS an AI valuation and is used as-is. These companies also form the peer pool used to derive the multiple below.
valuation_bases.derived: Company is diversified. We take its AI-attributed ARR and multiply by the pure-play median EV/Revenue multiple to obtain an implied 'what would this AI business be worth standalone' valuation.
valuation_bases.proxy: Company discloses no AI-attributed revenue, so no AI valuation can be derived. Full market cap is used as a flagged proxy and the ARR axis is scored at 0. These are the weakest-evidence rows in the list.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.valuation_source: $852B held flat through a self-funded $7B employee tender completed Aug 10, 2026 (CNBC). A ~$1.4T / $30B bridge round is in EARLY, UNSIGNED talks (Bloomberg, Sep 29 2026) - not used, since $852B is the last confirmed mark.
companies.arr_source: Financial Times, confirmed by Reuters (Oct 9, 2026): ~$50B annualised run-rate. NOTE: an earlier ~$70B figure (Axios, Sep 29) was revised DOWN because it counted gross cloud-partner sales; OpenAI books only its net share. Q3-2026 revenue growth: +77% overall, +107% enterprise. ChatGPT ads $1B annualised; 1.2B WAU.
companies.summary: Creator of GPT-4/5, ChatGPT (800M+ MAUs), DALL-E, Sora. Largest private AI company by both valuation and ARR.
companies.arr_attribution_note: 100% AI. OpenAI is a pure-play AI company.

companies.name: SpaceXAI (xAI + Cursor + X)
companies.category: Foundation Models / AI Coding / Consumer AI
companies.hq: Palo Alto & San Francisco, USA (SpaceXAI division of SpaceX)
companies.valuation_date: Feb 2, 2026 (xAI) & Aug 14, 2026 (Cursor) - both SpaceX acquisitions closed
companies.valuation_source: Sum of disclosed all-stock acquisition prices: xAI $250B (SpaceX, closed Feb 2 2026, 0.1433 SpaceX shares per xAI share) + Anysphere/Cursor $60B (SpaceX, signed Jun 16 2026, closed Aug 14 2026, ~391M SpaceX Class A shares). SpaceX itself IPO'd on Nasdaq Jun 12, 2026 at ~$1.77T market cap.
companies.arr_date: Q2 2026 segment actual ($2.561B) + Cursor $4B ARR consolidated from Aug 14, 2026
companies.arr_source: SpaceX SEC filings: AI segment revenue $2.561B in Q2 2026 (+247% YoY), $818M in Q1 2026, $3.2B FY2025; AI segment operating loss $6.4B FY2025. Cursor contributed a $4B ARR run-rate at close (SpaceX announcement). Grok's own product ARR was last pegged at ~$500M (Bloomberg, mid-2026). Grok: 117M MAU, 1.9M paying SuperGrok subscribers (S-1, Mar 2026).
companies.arr_attribution_note: Single consolidated entity: xAI (Grok) + Cursor (Anysphere) + X. ARR = Q2 2026 AI segment revenue $2.561B annualised ($10.2B) + Cursor's $4B ARR (consolidated from Aug 14 2026). The segment also carries four compute-rental contracts worth ~$41B annualised at their stated rates by Dec 2026 (Anthropic $1.25B/mo to May 2029, Google $920M/mo from Oct 2026, Reflection AI $150M/mo, plus a new $1.11B/mo deal) - that ramp is the single biggest forward swing factor and is NOT in the $14.2B above. Grok, Cursor, Grok Bot and X Premium were unified into a single 'X Subscription' on Oct 12-13, 2026.
companies.summary: Consolidated AI business of SpaceX: Grok foundation models + Cursor AI coding ($4B ARR) + the X platform. Acquired by SpaceX in two all-stock deals ($250B for xAI in Feb 2026, $60B for Cursor in Aug 2026). Now also runs a large GPU-compute-rental business leasing Colossus capacity to Anthropic, Google and others.

companies.name: Microsoft (AI business)
companies.category: Big Tech AI - Enterprise AI & Cloud
companies.valuation_date: Derived: AI ARR x peer multiple
companies.valuation_source: DERIVED. Microsoft does not publish an AI-segment market cap. We impute one using the peer EV/Revenue multiple derived from the pure-play set (see methodology sec. 6b). Full-company market cap is not used because ~85% of Microsoft revenue is non-AI (Windows, Office, Gaming, LinkedIn, search).
companies.arr_date: Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended Mar 31, 2026) - not restated at Q4
companies.arr_source: Microsoft FY26 Q3 earnings call, Apr 29 2026 (Nadella): 'Our AI business surpassed $37 billion ARR, up 123%.' Q4 FY26 (Jul 29 2026) did NOT restate a consolidated AI-ARR figure; it gave proxies instead: M365 Copilot >30M paid seats, Copilot revenue +60% QoQ, Azure revenue >$100B for the first time, Azure growth +43%, commercial RPO $678B (+84%). FY26 total revenue $331.8B.
companies.arr_attribution_note: AI business ARR as disclosed by Microsoft ($37B, +123% YoY). Most transparently disclosed AI revenue figure of any diversified company in this list.
companies.summary: Copilot family (M365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Security Copilot, consumer Copilot) + Azure AI services + first-party models. The largest disclosed AI business ARR of any diversified tech company.

companies.name: Google / Alphabet (AI: Gemini + Cloud AI)
companies.category: Big Tech AI - Foundation Models & Cloud AI
companies.valuation_date: Derived: AI ARR x peer multiple
companies.valuation_source: DERIVED from AI-attributed revenue x peer EV/Revenue multiple. Alphabet's full market cap is not used: search, YouTube, Android and Play remain the majority of revenue.
companies.arr_source: ESTIMATE. Alphabet does not disclose standalone Gemini revenue. Anchors: Google Cloud Q2 2026 revenue $24.768B (+82% YoY, run-rate ~$99B) with management attributing the acceleration to 'enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure'; revenue from products built on gen-AI models grew ~800% YoY (Q1 2026); Gemini app 950M MAU; Gemini Enterprise in ~90% of the Fortune 100; Gemini API 22B tokens/min; Vertex AI usage 25x YoY; Google One AI subscriptions. Estimate = AI-attributable share of Cloud run-rate + Gemini API + consumer AI subscriptions.
companies.arr_attribution_note: AI-attributable ARR is an ESTIMATE, not a disclosure - flagged as such. Google Cloud total run-rate ~$99B; we attribute a minority share to AI products plus Gemini API and consumer AI plans.
companies.summary: Gemini model family, Gemini app (950M MAU), Gemini Enterprise agent platform, Vertex AI, TPUs, and Google One AI subscriptions. 3.0+ has been revenue driver of Google Cloud for the first time.

companies.category: Big Tech AI - Consumer AI & Foundation Models
companies.valuation_date: 2024-25 private round (stale - no new mark disclosed)
companies.valuation_source: Private company; no 2026 primary mark disclosed. Last known valuation ~$300B. Used as a market-cap proxy because ByteDance discloses no AI-attributed revenue.
companies.arr_source: Not disclosed. Doubao assistant 260M+ MAU in Q1 2026 (overtaking ERNIE Bot for the first time) and 345M+ MAU by mid-2026; Volcano Engine AI cloud; Seedance video models; 2026 capex estimates $23-70B depending on source (all third-party, none company-confirmed).
companies.arr_attribution_note: No AI-revenue disclosure. This row scores on valuation alone (market-cap proxy) and is one of the weakest evidence bases in the list.
companies.summary: China's largest AI consumer platform by users: Doubao assistant (345M+ MAU), Seed model family, Seedance video, and Volcano Engine AI cloud. Occupies ~1/5 of China's delivered datacenter capacity.

exclusions.reason: Excluded from the ranked top 100 because the company is hardware-first, robotics-first, semiconductor-first, physically-manufactured, or has no disclosed AI revenue line. They are not 'pure-play digital AI'.

examples.name: CoreWeave
examples.why: GPU-as-a-service cloud (datacenter physical infra + GPUs as the core IP)

examples.name: Apple
examples.why: Apple Intelligence is not separately monetized - no AI revenue line exists. Its $4.95T market cap is a consumer-electronics franchise, and including it would make the valuation axis a measure of hardware franchises, not AI.

examples.name: Broadcom
examples.why: Semiconductor / networking silicon (incl. custom AI ASICs)

examples.name: Tesla
examples.why: Autos; AI only via the autonomy stack (excluded as physical)

examples.name: SpaceX (parent)
examples.why: Launch + space infrastructure. Only its SpaceXAI division is digital AI, and that division IS ranked separately as 'SpaceXAI (xAI + Cursor + X)'.

examples.name: Codeium / Windsurf
examples.why: Acquired by Cognition Jul 14, 2025; ARR now rolled into Cognition's consolidated figure. Removed to avoid double counting.
